purpose: Bounded Qualcomm Wi-Fi prior-art comparison and next experiment selection
assessment_limits: Published source and authors' reported results were inspected; upstream code was not built or executed.
Repository and branch review was selective, not exhaustive. Search absence does not establish global novelty.
Phone capability settings came from retained diagnostics; the current read-only refresh failed.
No new vulnerability, functional dual-STA test, CFR sample or spectral sample was established on this OnePlus.

sources.note: Three V61 requests with matching driver ACKs and router corroboration; no over-air recording of those transmissions.
Four counters stayed zero; receipt and rejection unestablished.
Reported STA+STA support and configuration; no two-association functional test.
Author-reported monitor capture and unsuccessful monitor TX path on OnePlus SM8750.
Published monitor injection implementation; not reproduced here.
March 2026 account describes Snapdragon 855 and a hidden station/helper approach; not universal to every later branch.
Inspected helper AP-vdev creation, firmware/DP peers and raw exception TX path. Aggregate saved diff has its own line numbers.
Sniffer TX handling change in selected direct-DP branch.
CFR relay configuration enablement is source evidence, not a working capture measurement.
OnePlus 13 frame-family limitations and references to alternate driver patches; differing builds and claims are not a controlled comparison.
Existing rooted Qualcomm phone spectral analyzer with hotspot-based workflow; author's Pixel 5 result is not a OnePlus result.

sources.title: Enabling Radio Spectrum Scan with Smartphones
sources.note: Read for platform and spectral acquisition prior art; no transfer of measured performance to this handset.
Author-reported QCA6490 CFR transport validation. Calibrated CSI reconstruction and physical antenna mapping remain unimplemented/unverified in the reviewed README.
Optional concurrency use cases, per-network callbacks, band-only multi-internet requests and per-interface behavior.
Interpretation of mode 2; setting value is not proof of a live connection pair.
Existing dual-connection identity correlation, quarantine and accounting concerns.
Prior isolation research across encryption, routing and switching; proposed tool is not credited with those attack discoveries.

search_scope.conclusion: No matching complete single-phone, independently calibrated two-endpoint isolation workflow identified in this bounded review. No global first claim.
